main_body: desert building with flat roof, turquoise dome, and sandstone brick front wall
top_band: light tan/sandstone flat roof terrace with parapet wall and turquoise dome, rows 3-33
evidence: Rows 3-33 clearly show the horizontal top surface of the flat roof (with inner parapet shadow on the north/west sides, a dome sitting on top, and a bright front-edge highlight at row 32-33). Row 34-36 shows a dark brown eave shadow directly over the brick front wall (rows 34-64) which features a recessed arched doorway and window.

style.evidence: The building uses rich multi-step ramps across the turquoise dome (6+ steps), speckled sandy roof terrace, and shaded sandstone bricks. Outlines use dark brown and deep teal material tones rather than black, matching the Beodeul reference craftsmanship closely.
